name: Zakomelye-Yarshevo-Yardenikha Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline (Ivanovo Oblast)

values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: No official GIS found. Trunk runs from the town of Gavrilov Posad through Zakomelye, Yarshevo, Zagorodny, Novoselka, Ivankovsky, Berezok, Glumovo, Vladychino, Skomovo to Yardenikha (Gavrilovo-Posadsky district); candidate for route-creation from settlement coordinates.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW. No roster match (no Ivanovo Oblast row besides proposed P3973 Puchezh-Yuryevets and P3974 Palekh-Lukh, different lines). Scope check passed: one named inter-settlement trunk, not village networks. neftegaz.ru (Gazprom Mezhregiongaz release of 2021-07-09, published 2021-07-12): Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Ivanovo began building a 40.3 km inter-settlement gas pipeline in Gavrilovo-Posadsky district serving 1098 households and 4 boiler houses in Zakomelye, Yarshevo, Zagorodny, Novoselka, Ivankovsky, Berezok, Glumovo, Vladychino, Skomovo and Yardenikha; completion planned 2022 under Gazprom's 2021-2025 gasification programme. ivteleradio.ru (2023-05-31, governor visit to Zakomelye): the inter-settlement pipeline from Gavrilov Posad was built under the Ivanovo 2021-2025 programme, is 'more than 40 km', passes through 10 settlements, and gas has arrived in Zakomelye; the 19.7 km of street distribution networks in five villages (separate rural-development programme) are NOT part of this line. Evidence for operating: that 2023 report only; the exact commissioning date is not stated in any fetched source (web-search summaries gave conflicting 2022/2023 dates, uncited), so StartYear is left blank. The two sources are not independent in origin (ivteleradio is regional TV, neftegaz repeats the Gazprom release) but are different publishers and both confirm length/route; tier high on single-validated-ref rule (one ref names pipeline settlements and states 40.3 km; the 2023 report confirms built). Start point 'Gavrilov Posad' from ivteleradio only; neftegaz does not name it. Owner is the operating subsidiary named in the source; entity_lookup found no close existing entity (new owner entity; Parent Gazprom not set, no verified ref for the parent link). Diameter, capacity, cost, pressure not found. Type 'distribution' because it is a Gazprom gas-distribution-company local trunk serving gasification; GEM already tracks distribution rows (e.g. P3973). Length 40.3 km is a design/announced figure (>40 km in 2023 report).
